newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world firms amid brisk fund buying.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world firms amid brisk fund buying.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures soared higher by midsession Monday amid fresh, technically driven fund buying, dealers said.
Producers were cited as steady scale-up sellers, but some of the early pressure was eroded as the funds carried the benchmark July contract to a high of 11.30 cents.
Second-position October climbed to a life-of-contract high of 11.10 cents, while March also reached a new contract high of 11.02 cents.
"The funds are adding new positions and no one wants to step out and sell the market down," a trader said.
Resistance could be found at each point higher as the producers are expected to continue to sell into the rally. Major resistance was cited at 10.50 cents basis the July contract.
At 1133 EDT, the July contract stood 0.12 cent firmer at 11.29 cents per lb, having ranged from 11.13 to a five-week high of 11.30 cents. The contract reached 11.37 cents on April 23.
October was up 0.11 to 11.11 cents, a lifetime high. The back months stood 0.02 to 0.09 cent firmer.
Traders said the market is strong technically, but added that a dearth of physical offtake could limit gains.
Open interest in most-active July fell by 1,229 lots to 73,042 lots as of early Friday, CSCE said.
An estimated 10,970 lots changed hands as of 1100 EDT.
